debrief db-021
1) the actor r-e-p-l-a-c-e-d the f-a-c-i-a-l t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s in the e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e and left a m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d i-m-a-g-e r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-s-i-o-n check.
2) the actor s-i-g-n-e-d in a l-o-g-g-i-n-g s-e-s-s-i-o-n as the d-o-c-t-o-r and left a n-e-w a-c-c-e-s-s k-e-y file while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-f-a step.
3) the actor s-c-a-n-n-e-d through the h-i-d-d-e-n door and left a m-o-t-i-o-n e-v-e-n-t in the s-e-n-s-o-r log while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the g-a-t-e-w-a-y check.
4) the actor m-i-n-e-d the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g s-t-r-e-a-m and left a f-a-l-s-e t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p entry while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l.
5) the actor d-e-l-e-t-e-d the b-a-c-k-u-p s-s-h-o-t and left an e-m-p-t-y r-e-s-t-o-r-e d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-h-e-c-k-s-u-m check.
